newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom wins ruling against Sixt.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom wins ruling against Sixt.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG on Thursday won a court decision restraining car rental firm Sixt AG from continuing an advertising campaign that referred negatively to Telekom, a Telekom spokesman said.

A Duesseldorf judge ruled the full-page ads, which ran in major German newspapers on Wednesday, damaged the competitive rights of the telecommunications giant, which launched its shares on world bourses on Monday, the spokesman said.
The Sixt ads took a stab at Telekom's own 100-million-mark pre-listing television advertising blitz, in which a well-known actor said Germans would be fools not to invest.
Sixt's advertisements said: "An actor speaks for the T-Share; the numbers speak for our stocks".
The Telekom spokesman said Sixt was trying to ride the coattails of the successful Telekom launching, and Telekom is considering further legal steps against the car rental firm.
